# Plugin (OpenAI)

An OpenAI plugin "is an installable bundle that can include skills and Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers" ([Skills and plugins][o13]): the way [skills][industry.skill] are distributed, not a skill itself ([Build skills][o12]).
